```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Package installation and loading
required_packages <- c('readr', 'ggpubr', 'stringr', 'gtsummary', 'flextable', 
                       'dplyr', 'tidyr', 'scales', 'pROC', 'ggstatsplot', 
                       'ggeffects', 'ggimage', 'cowplot', 'ggsci', 'lme4', 'lmerTest',
                       'pals', 'forcats')

  if (!require(name, character.only = TRUE)) {

    if (!require(name, character.only = TRUE)) stop("Package not found")
  }
}

# Figures are written to plots/ (ggsave does not create the folder)
```

```{r functions}
# Read an export with the identifier columns as text: read_csv guesses the type of each file
# separately (e.g. common_id holds cohort-2 identifiers in train/val and cohort-1 identifiers
# in test), and files of different types cannot be bound
read_export <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, col_types = cols(split = col_character(), id1 = col_character(), id2 = col_character(),
                                  common_id = col_character(), .default = col_guess()))
}

# Bind exports; any other column read as text in one file and as a number in another (e.g. a
# clinical variable) is kept as text, with a message (columns only NA in a file are fine)
bind_exports <- function(dfs) {
  dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), dfs)
  for (col in unique(unlist(lapply(dfs, names)))) {
    types <- unique(unlist(lapply(dfs, function(d) if (col %in% names(d) && !all(is.na(d[[col]]))) class(d[[col]])[1])))
    if (length(types) > 1) {
      message("Column ", col, " read as ", paste(types, collapse = " and "), ": kept as text")
      dfs <- lapply(dfs, function(d) { if (col %in% names(d)) d[[col]] <- as.character(d[[col]]); d })
    }
  }
  bind_rows(dfs)
}

# Function to load and combine datasets
# An export missing because its prediction file is not available (see export_R_data.py) is
# left out with a message; the analyses below then use the populations that are present.
load_and_combine <- function(path_prefix, seq_length_label) {
  files <- paste0(path_prefix, "_", c("val", "test", "train"), "_", seq_length_label, ".csv")
  missing <- files[!file.exists(files)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) message("Not available, left out: ", paste(basename(missing), collapse = ", "))
  if (length(missing) == length(files)) return(NULL)

  df_combined <- bind_exports(lapply(files[file.exists(files)], read_export))
  df_combined$seq_length <- seq_length_label
  return(df_combined)
}

# Function to prepare plotting variables
prepare_plot_vars <- function(df) {
  df$`Sequence Length` <- factor(df$seq_length, 
                                  levels = c("training", "block", "full"),
                                  labels = c("20s random sequence", "25s task synchronized", "Full sequence"))
  
  df$`Population` <- factor(df$split, 
                            levels = c("train", "val", "test"),
                            labels = c("FINA: training set", "FINA: test set", "RAW: external validation set"))
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      true_class = case_when(
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_worry ~ "worry",
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_neutral ~ "neutral", 
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_reappraisal ~ "reappraisal"
      ),
      # Absolute errors
      wae = abs(pred_worry - label_worry),
      nae = abs(pred_neutral - label_neutral),
      rae = abs(pred_reappraisal - label_reappraisal),
      aae = (wae + nae + rae) / 3
    )
  
  return(df)
}

# Function to calculate AUCs safely
# The direction is fixed (higher prediction = positive class): with pROC's default
# direction = "auto", the direction is chosen per subject from the medians, so a
# subject below chance gets 1 - AUC.
safe_auc <- function(response, predictor, quiet = TRUE) {
  tryCatch({
    as.numeric(auc(response, predictor, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), direction = "<", quiet = quiet))
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

# Function to find local maxima with constraints
find_local_maxima <- function(x, y, n_max = 3, min_distance = 5) {
  if(length(y) < 3) return(data.frame())
  
  peaks <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == -2) + 1
  peaks <- c(peaks, length(y))
  
  if(length(peaks) == 0) return(data.frame())
  
  peak_values <- y[peaks]
  sorted_peaks <- peaks[order(peak_values, decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  selected_peaks <- c()
  for(peak in sorted_peaks) {
    if(length(selected_peaks) >= n_max) break
    if(length(selected_peaks) == 0 || all(abs(x[peak] - x[selected_peaks]) >= min_distance)) {
      selected_peaks <- c(selected_peaks, peak)
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(
    timepoint = x[selected_peaks],
    shap_value = y[selected_peaks]
  )
}

# Last second of the 25 s window (timepoint 25 after the +1 below): the explained output is the
# prediction at that second, so its own input carries a large attribution by construction
# (recency of the LSTM output), not a brain effect. It is left out of the SHAP figures and models.
last_timepoint_excluded <- 25

# Network SHAP of the blocks of one condition (class_label; "" = all blocks and the 54 columns),
# one row per block, second and network. Two quantities:
#   shap_value  |projection| of the block-normalised SHAP map on the network template
#               (export_R_data.py): the AMOUNT, comparable across seconds, networks and conditions
#   shap_rank   min-max of shap_value across the networks within each block and second: the
#               relative RANK of the network at that second. Scaling block by block keeps it
#               independent of the number of blocks of a condition (16 Worry, 10 Neutral,
#               8 Reappraisal per participant); pooling the blocks of a participant compressed Worry.
# The selection of the networks (times_max) and their order in the figures use the rank; the
# curves use the amount.
prepare_shap_network_data <- function(df, class_label, split_filter = "test", times_max_threshold = 0.1, ids = NULL) {
  shap_col_pattern <- paste0("shap_network_", class_label)
  
  plot_data <- df %>%
    filter(split == split_filter) %>%
    mutate(
      true_class = case_when(
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_worry ~ "worry",
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_neutral ~ "neutral", 
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_reappraisal ~ "reappraisal"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(class_label == "" | true_class == class_label) %>%
    select(id1, id2, block_id, timepoint, contains(shap_col_pattern), rate, pswq_total, age, sex, hars_score, rsq_total, true_class) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains(shap_col_pattern), 
                 names_to = "network", 
                 values_to = "shap_value") %>%
    mutate(
      network = gsub(shap_col_pattern, "", network), 
      shap_value = abs(shap_value), 
      timepoint = timepoint + 1
    ) %>%
    filter(timepoint < last_timepoint_excluded) %>%
    group_by(id1, id2, block_id, timepoint) %>%
    mutate(shap_rank = (shap_value - min(shap_value)) / (max(shap_value) - min(shap_value))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(network, timepoint) %>%
    mutate(mean_shap = mean(shap_rank, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    mutate(is_max_mean = mean_shap == max(mean_shap, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(network) %>%
    mutate(times_max = mean(is_max_mean)) %>%
    ungroup() 
  
  if (is.null(ids)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      filter(times_max >= times_max_threshold)
  }
  else{
    top_networks <- plot_data %>%
      distinct(network, times_max) %>%
      arrange(desc(times_max)) %>%
      slice(ids) %>%
      pull(network)
    
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      filter(network %in% top_networks)
  }
  
  return(plot_data)
}

# Mean of each participant over its blocks, so that the 95 % confidence intervals of the
# figures (add = "mean_ci") are computed across participants and not across blocks
participant_means <- function(plot_data) {
  plot_data %>%
    group_by(id1, id2, true_class, network, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(shap_value = mean(shap_value, na.rm = TRUE),
              shap_rank = mean(shap_rank, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r data_loading}
# Load all datasets
df_block <- load_and_combine("./data/export", "block")
df_full <- load_and_combine("./data/export", "full")

# Combine all datasets
df <- bind_exports(list(df_training, df_block, df_full))

# Load SHAP data

# Clean environment
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("df", "df_block_withshap", lsf.str())))

  df_block_withshap <- df_block_withshap %>%

      true_class = case_when(
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_worry ~ "worry",
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_neutral ~ "neutral", 
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_reappraisal ~ "reappraisal"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r lmer_analysis, fig.height=14, fig.width=6}
# Calculate blockwise MAE
mae_data <- df %>%
  filter(seq_length == "block", split == "test") %>%
  group_by(id1, block_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mae = mean(abs(aae), na.rm = TRUE),
    rating = (first(rating)-1)/(5-1),
    pswq_total = (first(pswq_total)-16)/(80-16),
    rsq_total = (first(rsq_total)-22)/(88-22),
    hars_score = first(hars_score)/56,
    true_class = first(true_class),
    age = (first(age)-50)/50,
    sex = first(sex),
    common_id = first(common_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Class = factor(true_class, 
                   levels = c("neutral", "worry", "reappraisal"),
                   labels = c("Neutral", "Worry", "Reappraisal")),
    Age = age,
    PSWQ = pswq_total,
    RSQ = rsq_total,
    HARS = hars_score,
    Rating = rating,
    Subject = id1
  )

# Run mixed effects model
# Enrollment: "RAW only" (common_id NA) vs "FINA and RAW" (reference: participants of RAW also
# enrolled in FINA). Same coding as the former common_id = is.na(common_id) (TRUE = RAW only):
# same estimate, sign and p value, only the term name changes (EnrollmentRAW only).
mae_data$Enrollment <- factor(ifelse(is.na(mae_data$common_id), "RAW only", "FINA and RAW"),
                              levels = c("FINA and RAW", "RAW only"))
model_formula <- mae ~ Age + Sex + PSWQ + RSQ + Rating + Rating*Class + RSQ*Class + HARS*Class + 
              PSWQ*Class + Sex*Class + Age*Class + Class + HARS + Enrollment + (1|Subject)
if (n_distinct(mae_data$Enrollment) < 2) {   # e.g. on a subset without participants of both studies
  message("Enrollment has a single level in these data: term left out of the model")
  model_formula <- update(model_formula, . ~ . - Enrollment)
}
model <- lmer(model_formula, data = mae_data)

summary(model)
anova(model)
g <- ggcoefstats(model, effects = "fixed", digits="signif3", exclude.intercept=TRUE, 
            sort="ascending", only.significant=TRUE, xlab = "Estimate", ylab = "Terms") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0), plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))

# wide enough for the term labels and the caption of ggcoefstats (cropped at width = 4)
ggsave("plots/figure_model_mae.png", plot = g, width = 8, height = 12, dpi = 300)
g
```

```{r mae_plots, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
tmp <- df %>% 
  gather("ae_type", "ae_value", aae, wae, nae, rae) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(ae_type, 
                           levels = c("aae", "wae", "nae", "rae"),
                           labels = c("Overall", "Worry", "Neutral", "Reappraisal")))

# Supplementary Figure 1 needs the 9 exports (3 populations x 3 window configurations)
complete_mae <- nrow(distinct(df, split, seq_length)) == 9
if (complete_mae) {
g_overall <- grouped_ggbetweenstats(
  data = tmp[tmp$Condition == "Overall",],
  x = `Sequence Length`,
  y = ae_value,
  grouping.var = Population,
  pairwise.display = "none",
  plotgrid.args = list(nrow = 1, ncol = 3),
  results.subtitle = FALSE,
  ggplot.component = list(
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10"),
    ylab("Absolute error (log10 scale)")
  )
)

ggsave("plots/figure_mae_overall.png", plot = g_overall, width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 300)
} else {
  # Partial version: the window configurations on the FINA test set (val), and the three
  # populations with the task blocks (figure_mae_overall.png is not written)
  overall <- tmp[tmp$Condition == "Overall",]
  for (part in list(
    list(data = filter(overall, split == "val"), x = "Sequence Length", file = "plots/figure_mae_overall_val_windows.png"),
    list(data = filter(overall, seq_length == "block"), x = "Population", file = "plots/figure_mae_overall_block_populations.png"))) {
    if (n_distinct(part$data[[part$x]]) < 2) next
    g <- ggbetweenstats(data = part$data, x = !!sym(part$x), y = ae_value, pairwise.display = "none",
                        results.subtitle = FALSE,
                        ggplot.component = list(scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10"),
                                                ylab("Absolute error (log10 scale)")))
    ggsave(part$file, plot = g, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
    print(g)
  }
}
```

```{r shap_temporal, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
tmp <- df_block_withshap %>%
  # last second left out before the 0-1 rescaling (recency of the explained output)
  filter(as.numeric(timepoint) + 1 < last_timepoint_excluded) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint) + 1,
    shap_all = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_")) %>% select(-starts_with("shap_network")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
      rescale(to = c(0, 1)),
    shap_worry = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_roi_worry_")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                 rescale(to = c(0, 1)),
    shap_neutral = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_roi_neutral_")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                   rescale(to = c(0, 1)),
    shap_reappraisal = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_roi_reappraisal_")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                       rescale(to = c(0, 1))
  ) %>% 
  gather("shap_condition", "shap_value", shap_worry, shap_neutral, shap_reappraisal, shap_all) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(shap_condition, 
                      levels = c("shap_all", "shap_worry", "shap_neutral", "shap_reappraisal"),
                      labels = c("Overall", "Worry", "Neutral", "Reappraisal")),
    Population = factor(split, 
                       levels = c("train", "val", "test"),
                       labels = c("FINA: training set", "FINA: test set", "RAW: external validation set"))
  ) %>%
  select(id1, id2, timepoint, shap_value, Condition, Population) %>%
  # one value per participant (95 % CI across participants, not across blocks)
  group_by(Population, Condition, id1, id2, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(shap_value = mean(shap_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

mean_data <- tmp %>%
  group_by(Population, Condition, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_shap = mean(shap_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

maxima_data <- mean_data %>%
  group_by(Population, Condition) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>%
  do(find_local_maxima(.$timepoint, .$mean_shap, 3, 5)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggline(tmp, x = "timepoint", y = "shap_value", color = "Condition", add = "mean_ci", 
       facet.by = "Population", numeric.x.axis = TRUE, palette = "lancet") + 
  geom_point(data = maxima_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = shap_value + 0.005, color = Condition), 
             shape = 8, size = 3) +
  xlab("Time (s) task synchronized") +
  ylab("smaShap") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1, size = 6))

ggsave("plots/figure_timing.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r auc_analysis, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
tmp <- df %>%
  group_by(id1, id2, `Sequence Length`) %>%
  mutate(
    auc_worry_all = safe_auc(true_class == "worry", pred_worry),
    auc_neutral_all = safe_auc(true_class == "neutral", pred_neutral),
    auc_reappraisal_all = safe_auc(true_class == "reappraisal", pred_reappraisal),
    auc_worry_neutral = safe_auc(true_class[true_class %in% c("worry", "neutral")] == "worry",
                                pred_worry[true_class %in% c("worry", "neutral")]),
    auc_worry_reappraisal = safe_auc(true_class[true_class %in% c("worry", "reappraisal")] == "worry",
                                    pred_worry[true_class %in% c("worry", "reappraisal")]),
    auc_neutral_reappraisal = safe_auc(true_class[true_class %in% c("neutral", "reappraisal")] == "neutral",
                                      pred_neutral[true_class %in% c("neutral", "reappraisal")])
  ) %>% 
  gather("auc_type", "auc_value", auc_worry_all, auc_neutral_all, auc_reappraisal_all, 
         auc_worry_neutral, auc_worry_reappraisal, auc_neutral_reappraisal) %>% 
  group_by(id1, id2, `Sequence Length`, auc_type) %>%
  summarise(Population = first(Population), auc_value = mean(auc_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(auc_type, 
                           levels = c("auc_worry_all", "auc_neutral_all", "auc_reappraisal_all", 
                                     "auc_worry_neutral", "auc_worry_reappraisal", "auc_neutral_reappraisal"),
                           labels = c("Worry vs Rest", "Neutral vs Rest", "Reappraisal vs Rest", 
                                     "Worry vs Neutral", "Worry vs Reappraisal", "Neutral vs Reappraisal")))

grouped_ggbetweenstats(
  data = tmp %>% filter(`Sequence Length` == "25s task synchronized"),
  x = Population,
  y = auc_value,
  grouping.var = Condition,
  type = "parametric",
  pairwise.display = "none",   # no test annotations on the figure (brackets, p values, caption)
  results.subtitle = FALSE,
  bf.message = FALSE,
  centrality.plotting = TRUE,
  ggplot.component = list(coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1)), ylab("AUC"),  # zoom only: ylim() would drop AUCs < 0.5
                          labs(caption = NULL))
)
ggsave("plots/figure_auc.png", width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r auc_val_windows, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
# AUC per participant of the FINA test set (code: val) for the three window configurations
# available on this population (20 s random windows, 25 s task blocks, full run). The same
# participants are measured with every configuration: repeated-measures tests, on the
# participants with an AUC for every configuration.
tmp_val <- tmp %>%
  filter(Population == "FINA: test set", !is.na(auc_value)) %>%
  mutate(participant = paste(id1, id2, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(Condition, participant) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(`Sequence Length`) == n_distinct(tmp$`Sequence Length`[tmp$Population == "FINA: test set"])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Condition, participant, `Sequence Length`) %>%
  droplevels()
if (n_distinct(tmp_val$`Sequence Length`) >= 2) {
  grouped_ggwithinstats(
    data = tmp_val,
    x = `Sequence Length`,
    y = auc_value,
    subject.id = participant,
    grouping.var = Condition,
    type = "parametric",
    pairwise.display = "none",   # no test annotations on the figure (brackets, p values, caption)
    results.subtitle = FALSE,
    bf.message = FALSE,
    centrality.plotting = TRUE,
    ggplot.component = list(coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1)), ylab("AUC"), labs(caption = NULL))
  )
  ggsave("plots/figure_auc_val_windows.png", width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
}
tmp %>%
  group_by(`Sequence Length`, Population, Condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_auc = mean(auc_value, na.rm = TRUE), sd_auc = sd(auc_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Condition, `Sequence Length`, Population) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r shap_summary}
df_block_withshap %>%
  filter(split == "test") %>%
  select(id1, id2, true_class, timepoint, contains("shap_network_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(contains("shap_network_"), names_to = "feature", values_to = "shap") %>%
  mutate(
    label = str_split_i(feature, "_", 3),
    network = sub("^([^_]+_){3}", "", feature)

  group_by(label, network) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(shap), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(label), desc(mean_abs_shap))
```

```{r fig.height=15, fig.width=5}
plot_data <- prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "", ids = 1:(18*3))

plot_dan <- plot_data %>%
    filter(str_detect(network, "SMA")) %>%
    separate(network, into = c("shap_class", "network"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(shap_class, "worry|neutral"), str_detect(true_class, "worry|neutral"), shap_class == true_class) %>%
    mutate(
      Class = factor(true_class),
      Focus = factor(shap_class),
      Sex = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
      Age = (age-50)/50,
      PSWQ = (pswq_total-16)/(80-16),
      RSQ = (rsq_total-22)/(88-22),
      HARS = hars_score/56,
      Rating = (rate-1)/4,  # 0-1 like in the MAE model (was rate - 1/4)
      Subject = id1
    )
# Outcome: rank of the SMA network among the 54 network columns within each block and second
# (shap_rank, see prepare_shap_network_data); shap_value would model the amount instead
model <- lmer(shap_rank ~ Age + Sex + PSWQ + RSQ + HARS + Rating + Class + Class*Age + Class*Sex + Class*PSWQ + Class*RSQ + Class*HARS + Class*Rating  + (timepoint|Subject), data = plot_dan)

summary(model)
g <- ggcoefstats(model, effects = "fixed", digits="signif3", exclude.intercept=TRUE, 
            sort="ascending", only.significant=TRUE, xlab = "Estimate", ylab = "Terms") 
ggsave("plots/figure_model_sma.png", plot = g, width = 4, height = 12, dpi = 300)
g
```

```{r shap_networks_reappraisal, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
library(pals)   # polychrome() when more than 10 networks are selected
network_labels <- c(
    "AnteriorHippocampus" = "Anterior Hippocampus",
    "anteriorDMN" = "Anterior Default Mode Network",
    "ASN" = "Anterior Salience Network",
    "Auditory" = "Auditory Cortex",
    "BasalGanglia" = "Basal Ganglia",
    "BilateralInsula" = "Bilateral Insula",
    "Cerebellum" = "Cerebellum",
    "DAN" = "Dorsal Attention Network",
    "FrontoLimbic" = "Frontolimbic Network",
    "Fusiform" = "Fusiform Gyrus",
    "left_ECN" = "Left Executive Control Network",
    "Motor" = "Motor Cortex",
    "PrimaryVisual" = "Primary Visual Cortex",
    "posteriorDMN" = "Posterior Default Mode Network",
    "right_ECN" = "Right Executive Control Network",
    "SecondaryVisual" = "Secondary Visual Cortex",
    "SMA" = "Supplementary Motor Network",
    "ventralDMN" = "Ventral Default Mode Network"
  )

plot_data <- prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "worry")
plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "neutral"))
plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "reappraisal"))
plot_data <- participant_means(plot_data)

# Networks selected by prepare_shap_network_data (times_max >= 0.1 in at least one condition),
# in the order of network_labels. The list was fixed before (7 networks of the first analysis):
# a network selected with the corrected projection but absent from that list became NA.
selected <- unique(as.character(str_replace(plot_data$network, "_", "")))
unknown <- setdiff(selected, names(network_labels))
if (length(unknown) > 0) stop("Networks without a label in network_labels: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
selected <- names(network_labels)[names(network_labels) %in% selected]
colors <- if (length(selected) <= 10) pal_npg()(length(selected)) else unname(polychrome(length(selected)))

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(network = factor(network_labels[as.character(str_replace(network, "_", ""))], levels = network_labels[selected]), network_color = colors[as.numeric(network)], Class = factor(str_to_title(true_class)))

col_vec <- setNames(unique(plot_data$network_color), unique(plot_data$network))
ggline(plot_data, x = "timepoint", y = "shap_value", 
       color = "network", add = "mean_ci", palette = col_vec, 
       numeric.x.axis = TRUE, facet.by = "Class") + 
  labs(x = "Time (s) task synchronized", y = "Network SHAP (block-normalised)", colour = "Networks") +
  facet_wrap(~Class, nrow = 2, ncol = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25))
ggsave("plots/figure_smaShap.png", width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
library(pals)
library(forcats) 
colors <- polychrome(18)

# Participant means of the 18 networks in each condition (curves: amount, shap_value;
# order of the networks and groups: rank, shap_rank)
shap_groups <- lapply(setNames(nm = c("worry", "neutral", "reappraisal")), function(label)
  participant_means(prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, label, ids = 1:18)))

# Same y axis for the 18 group plots (6 groups x 3 conditions): range of the means and of
# their 95 % confidence intervals across participants (as drawn by add = "mean_ci") over all networks
group_ylim <- bind_rows(shap_groups) %>%
  group_by(true_class, network, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(shap_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            h = qt(0.975, pmax(sum(!is.na(shap_value)) - 1, 1)) * sd(shap_value, na.rm = TRUE) /
                sqrt(sum(!is.na(shap_value))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(lo = min(m - h, na.rm = TRUE), hi = max(m + h, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  unlist()

for (label in names(shap_groups)){
  plot_data <- shap_groups[[label]] %>%
    mutate(
      network = factor(network_labels[as.character(str_replace(network, "_", ""))], levels = network_labels),
      network_color = colors[as.numeric(network)]
    ) %>%
    group_by(network) %>%
    mutate(mean_rank = mean(shap_rank, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_rank), network, id1, id2, timepoint) %>%
    mutate(
      network = fct_inorder(network),
      network_group = paste0('Group ', ntile(row_number(), 6))
    )
  
  col_vec <- setNames(unique(plot_data$network_color), unique(plot_data$network))
  
  for(grp in 1:6){
    p <- plot_data %>%
      filter(network_group == paste("Group", grp)) %>%
      ggline(x = "timepoint", y = "shap_value", color = "network", 
             add = "mean_ci", palette = col_vec, numeric.x.axis = TRUE) + 
      coord_cartesian(ylim = group_ylim) +   # same y axis for all groups and conditions
      labs(x = "Time (s) task synchronized", y = "Network SHAP (block-normalised)", 
           colour = "Networks")
    ggsave(paste0("plots/shap_", label, "_group", grp, ".png"), p, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}
```
